item: copy response + export conversation (15.4): a hover copy control on every finished assistant text block copies its markdown source; the header's Export popup asks the CLI for the terminal's /export text and copies or saves it
branch: mdBlock()/copyable() (js/20-markdown.js) append .blk-copy once a block is final — finishBubble() at content_block_stop / message_stop / result / tool start / message_start on the live path, mdBlock on the whole-message, local-command, synthetic-echo and replay paths; the click copies el.__md through bridge{kind:'copy'} (Kotlin's CopyPasteManager — navigator.clipboard needs focus + a user activation the webview does not always hold). exportBtn → tg('exportMenu') + bridge{kind:'export'} once per open; __export{text, default_filename} → rows on + footer count, {text:''} → 'Nothing to export yet.', {error} → 'Could not prepare the conversation: …'; Copy writes the text and reports in the footer; Save sends bridge{kind:'exportSave', name, text} and closes; an answer to a closed popup is dropped; __clear closes and forgets. __exit while loading → the exit text in the footer. Placement (2026-10-11): .blk-copy is the block's first child, floated right, opacity-hidden until hover; `.blk > .blk-copy + *` loses its top margin; .codeblock/.diff clear right.

Stream frames are the panel's measured shapes (fixture 93's text/tool/text message). Copies are read off the bridge tape; the real system clipboard was read back with xclip in the live check.
